The '''Auction Agents''' are [[NPC]]s located in the {{zone|Auction House}}.

== Interface ==
{{:Auction House/UI}}

== Usage ==
Right-clicking on any Auction Agent will open the [[Auction House]] menus.

== Trivia ==
* Trying to get too close to any of the Auction Agents (or the [[Auction Master]]) will get the player pushed away. Doing this a few times will teleport you outside the [[Auction House]].
* In the [https://hypixel.net/threads/6063723/ 0.24.2] update, the size of the physical {{zone|Auction House}} was reduced, with which the number of '''Auction Agents''' dropped.
